### THE OPERATOR'S POINT, and it is the right one
The capstone renders TWICE on the live Cloud Master hub (Labs + Projects, same href, different
copy). I built a de-dup fix. He asked the better question: **if it is a lab it cannot be a
project.** The data says LAB in three independent places -- it lives in `labs/`, it is named
`.lab.html`, and the catalog types it `components:['lab']`. It was hand-registered onto a
Projects shelf for prominence.

**So my fix picks the WRONG WINNER.** Curated-wins keeps the Projects card (the mislabel) and
drops the Labs card (the honest one). The RULE is still right in general -- a human choosing a
shelf should beat an automatic one -- but here the curation itself is wrong. Fix the data, not
the rule.

### STRUCTURAL FINDING UNDERNEATH IT
`components:['project']` appears **0 times** in the entire catalog (vs 1003 `['lab']`). So
`BUCKET.project` can NEVER fire: **every hub's Projects shelf is dead unless hand-written.**
Cloud Master's has one item only because `functions/register-capstone-project.js` ran once.
